description.summary: You create a suit of glowing, black barding for your mount to wear
description.value: You create a suit of glowing, black barding for your mount to wear. The armor appears on your mount, fitting perfectly. The black barding you create has no armor check penalty and has no effect on your mount’s speed. The exact nature of the barding depends on your caster level. 1st—3rd: Copper chain barding (+4 armor bonus). 4th—5th: Silver chain barding (+5). 6th—7th: Bronze plate barding (+6). 8th—9th: Mythril plate barding (+7). 10th+: Adamantine plate barding (+8).
